# NewsEdition

> NewsEdition is an independent Indian digital news platform founded in 2024 by Amit Gautam (Founder and Editor-in-Chief). It publishes news on India, politics, business, world affairs, entertainment, governance and Haryana, in English.

NewsEdition articles carry a named author, a publication time and a last-updated time. Author pages list each author's published work.

## Sections

- [India](https://newsedition.in/india): national news and updates
- [World](https://newsedition.in/world): international news and its impact on India
- [Politics](https://newsedition.in/politics): parties, Parliament, elections and policy
- [Business](https://newsedition.in/business): markets, economy, companies and startups
- [Entertainment](https://newsedition.in/entertainment): film, television and culture
- [Governance](https://newsedition.in/governance): government decisions, schemes and administration
- [State](https://newsedition.in/state): news from Indian states
- [Haryana News](https://newsedition.in/haryana-news): local news from Haryana

## About the publisher

- [About NewsEdition](https://newsedition.in/about): who runs the site and why it exists
- [Editorial Policy](https://newsedition.in/editorial-policy): who runs the site, how AI tools are used and labelled
- [Corrections Policy](https://newsedition.in/corrections): how to report an error
- [Grievance Officer](https://newsedition.in/grievance): who handles complaints about content, and how to reach them
- [Contact](https://newsedition.in/contact): how to reach the newsroom
- [Privacy Policy](https://newsedition.in/privacy)
- [Terms of Service](https://newsedition.in/terms)

## For crawlers and feeds

- [RSS feed](https://newsedition.in/feed.xml): the 50 newest articles
- [XML sitemap](https://newsedition.in/sitemap.xml): all published pages
- [Google News sitemap](https://newsedition.in/news-sitemap.xml): stories from the last two days
